description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseTextFilter' for text filtering components within the Pipecat framework. It specifies the interface and core methods for implementing text filters, including settings updates, text filtering, and interruption handling.

classes.name: BaseTextFilter
classes.description: Abstract base class for text filters in the Pipecat framework, providing an interface for updating settings, filtering text, and handling interruptions.

methods.name: update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously update the filter's configuration settings. To be implemented by subclasses for handling dynamic configuration updates during runtime.

methods.name: str filter(self, text: str)
methods.description: Abstract method that applies specific filtering transformations to the input text. Must be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Handle interruption events to reset internal state or cleanup. To be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: reset_interruption(self)
methods.description: Reset the filter state after an interruption. To be implemented by subclasses.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, text: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: update_settings
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any]):$/
